title: NL → CQL2 LLM response
description: The JSON object the LLM is prompted to return. Validated at the boundary (parseResponse.ts) before the generator returns a GenerationResult. Any deviation populates GenerationResult.error. Shape reflects review decisions 2A/5A (lozenges reuse the FilterBar chip seed shape) and 8A (cql2-evaluation-failed reason).

cql2.description: A CQL2-JSON object. Empty object {} means no filter (match all). Must round-trip via cql2JsonToFilterExpression and must reference only CQL2 properties declared in the filter-engine's PROPERTY_MAP.

lozenges.description: One entry per human-intelligible filter dimension. Uses the seed shape — Pick<LozengeItem, 'filterType'|'value'|'negated'> — so consumers assemble the full LozengeItem with their own ID generation. Compound predicates (e.g. nationality + domain) are expressed as separate seeds only when the filter-engine would model them as separate Predicates; a single array_filter over platforms produces one seed with filterType='vessel-class' (or similar platform-scoped type).

filterType.description: Must match a value in the filter-engine FilterType union. Prompt derives the allowed list from PROPERTY_MAP at build time; parseResponse validates it at runtime.

unrecognised_terms.description: Terms from the phrase that did not match any enum value. Must not appear as predicate values inside cql2; parseResponse enforces this via a tree-walking visitor.
